blocks.text: Ducal Freight is a regional freight company serving the Mountain West. We move freight for manufacturers, distributors and retailers across five states.
We run 30 yards and cross-docks, from busy city terminals to small yards at the edge of town. Most of our freight is on the road for less than a day.
Every trailer that comes through one of our docks is inspected, coming in and going out: seals, doors, tires, the load and any damage. If something's wrong, we want to find it at our dock, not yours.
Safety audits are part of how we run, not something we prepare for once a year. Our customers and their auditors can ask for the inspection record for any trailer we've handled.
Looking for a freight partner in the Mountain West? Our operations team would like to hear from you.
